A vehicle description (color and body style or make) recorded at two or more incidents.

Supporting but generic facts: all three are commercial premises in New Orleans with forced entry. Forced entry is a common method, so these facts do not carry the link by themselves.

Nothing contradicts the link. The cities, scene types and method are compatible, and the dates are close. The different blocks (1600 S Gayoso, 300 N Carrollton, 3600 Prytania) don't contradict it, because no neighborhoods are reported and the sites are in the same city.

Weaknesses to keep in mind: NEW-040 and NEW-041 are classed as attempts and NEW-042 as a burglary, which may be a difference in outcome rather than in method. No items are reported taken. This is an investigative lead, not a confirmed series.
